title: Revisit ADR 0008 for self-contained release artifact model
description: ADR 0008 (Node runtime + native better-sqlite3 support) was written when npm install was the only distribution path, so it never distinguished dev/workspace install policy from release CI native-build policy from end-user artifact install policy. The release model has since moved to self-contained per-platform archives (ADR 0003/eshyra-upef, ADR 0011) that bundle a pinned Node runtime + ABI-matched better-sqlite3 prebuild + the app tree; end users never run npm install or compile anything. Supersede or amend ADR 0008 to encode this three-layer policy split.
acceptance_criteria: New/amended ADR documents: (1) released artifacts must never run npm install or native compilation on the end-user machine; (2) an explicit decision on whether release CI may source-compile better-sqlite3 when upstream prebuilds are unavailable or prebuild-install tooling risk becomes unacceptable; (3) a requirement for artifact smoke tests on a clean target environment lacking native build tools, with follow-up bead filed for the concrete CI implementation if not done in this bead; (4) explicit bundling requirement that the Node runtime and native addon match OS/arch/Node ABI; (5) the existing guard that moving Node majors requires an explicit dependency/runtime decision is preserved. AGENTS.md/docs/dependencies.md updated if the split changes any stated policy. eshyra-nkbo (npm deprecation warning bead) closed/annotated referencing the dev/workspace-layer decision.
close_reason: Merged as PR #378 (merge commit 4fdad8a). ADR 0016 lands the three-layer native-install model and pre-authorizes source-build-first as a future non-policy implementation choice, keeping the current prebuilt-first default. Net diff docs-only. eshyra-nkbo closed won't-fix; eshyra-w7bp (clean-env smoke) remains open as follow-up.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text:
Correction applied per user feedback: the intended decision was to flip dev/workspace AND release-CI layers to source-build-first (not merely accept source-compile as a release-CI fallback). Implemented via a checked-in root .npmrc (build-from-source=true). This required real follow-up fixes beyond docs:

- ci.yml's install-smoke log-scan inverted (now requires source-build evidence, fails on unexpected downloaded prebuild). First attempt used a Windows-incompatible compiler-line pattern; fixed to rely solely on node-gyp's cross-platform "gyp info ok" line, verified via real GitHub Actions runs on Linux/macOS/Windows.
- Removed redundant per-workflow npm_config_build_from_source env vars (ci.yml, release.yml, srd-freeze-guard.yml, srd-importer-reproducibility.yml); build-release-artifact.mjs's --global --prefix install keeps an explicit override since it doesn't inherit repo .npmrc.
- Discovered and fixed a real release-build regression: compiling better-sqlite3 from source also builds its test_extension helper target + ~18MB of node-gyp intermediates, which tripped validate-release-artifact.mjs's stray-native-binary check. Added pruneNativeBuildByproducts() to build-release-artifact.mjs. Verified via a full GitHub Actions Release run: all 16 edition x platform legs + installer-smoke pass.
- Added a thaw note for srd-freeze-guard.yml (a frozen exact path) since removing its env block tripped the SRD freeze changed-path check.

All workflows (CI, Release, SRD frozen artifact guard, SRD importer reproducibility) pass on the final commit c252672. PR #378 updated.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text:
Final direction (per review): reverted the source-build-first flip; kept ADR 0016 reframed as permissive rather than mandatory.

Rationale: the flip bought resiliency (no hard dependency on prebuild-install's deprecated download path) but did NOT remove the deprecation warning (prebuild-install stays a declared dep of better-sqlite3 either way) and added per-install compile time + a mandatory toolchain everywhere. Not worth forcing now.

ADR 0016 now: (a) three-layer model (dev/workspace, release-CI, end-user artifact); (b) ADR 0008's prebuilt-first default stays in force; (c) pre-authorizes opting layers 1-2 into source-build-first later as an implementation choice with NO new policy ADR, recording the four validated conditions (mandatory toolchain; invert ci.yml compile-evidence guard keyed on `gyp info ok`; prune node-gyp byproducts incl test_extension.node from release artifacts; longer builds); (d) layer 3 = hard rule (end-user artifact never compiles). ADR 0008 gets a pointer note; AGENTS.md gets a one-line pointer.

Net PR diff vs main is docs-only. All CI green (build-test + install-smoke Linux/Win/mac, CodeQL). PR #378 updated. eshyra-nkbo stays closed won't-fix; eshyra-w7bp (clean-env smoke) stays open.
